scenario: AITA For telling my Girlfriend she needs to quit whining about who eats what or I'll kick her out | Well, the title says it all, the past few weeks have both been really great and extremely infuriating. Well she eats more then any person I have ever known, especially considering her physical appearance, she is 5'4, petite, thin and yet she eats more than I do and I am 6'6 and a bit of a gymbro. So I told her that this crap was either going to stop right here and now or I'll kick her out and she can spend the coming weeks or months at her own place.
